s.note: Cheddar, Red Leicester and Wensleydale diamonds with crackers and pickled onions
s.how: Cut 150g aged cheddar, 150g Red Leicester and 150g Wensleydale into sharp little diamond shapes. Arrange on a board with crackers and pickled onions. Don't swallow any of the diamonds.

s.note: Browned chipolatas glazed in honey and wholegrain mustard, on toothpicks
s.how: Grill 500g chipolatas until browned. Toss in a hot pan with 2 tbsp honey and 2 tbsp wholegrain mustard until sticky. Spear on toothpicks and serve hot with extra mustard.

m.note: Sirloin seared medium rare, creamed spinach, baked potato
m.how: Bake 4 potatoes at 200C for 1 hour. Season 4 thick sirloins and sear in a smoking pan 3 to 4 minutes a side to 54C inside, then rest 5 minutes. Wilt 400g spinach with a crushed garlic clove, add 150ml cream and 30g parmesan and reduce until thick. Mix 150g sour cream with 2 tbsp horseradish cream. Split the potatoes, add butter and serve with the steak.

w.note: Caramel and banana on a biscuit crust under whipped cream
w.how: Press 250g crushed biscuits mixed with 120g melted butter into a pie dish and chill. Spread with 380g tinned caramel, layer 3 sliced bananas, top with 300ml whipped cream and grated chocolate.

d.note: Irish whiskey, lime and ginger beer over ice
d.how: Fill four tall glasses with ice. Add 45ml Irish whiskey and the juice of half a lime to each. Top with 150ml cold ginger beer and stir once. Garnish with a lime wedge and a thin slice of fresh ginger.
